dct_description_sm: These data were as part of a study seeking to understand the population-limiting factors of this isolated caribou herd. In the context of this study, the body condition data were collected to aid in a study of Coats Island caribou nutritional ecology, via the development of an accurate, rapid method of determining body composition from readily-measurable indices on shot caribou.
dct_title_s: Body condition for the Coats Island Herd, 1982-1984 -Adamczewski data
